notes: The interferogram measures nothing here (sea and fresh lava both decorrelate), so values come from pipeline.newland: GCOV HH backscatter medians on both stacks, 20 m cells (new_land_ha, new_bright_cells_at_sea). The boundary text expected the new land 'along the W shore'; NISAR finds most of it on the S and SW shore, so the W/NW fact says Badan Geologi reported it there and NISAR sees only a little. Islet positions are distance-and-bearing estimates (+-a few hundred m), so their patches are 500 m circles.

facts.title: New land on the south and south-west shore
facts.text: After the 4-6 September eruption, NISAR's backscatter shows about 23 ha of new land along the cone's south and south-west shore: sea-dark on every pass before, rock-bright from the first pass after (6 September) on. Sentinel-2 agrees.
facts.source: NISAR analysis (GCOV backscatter, ascending and descending)

facts.title: West and north-west shore: less new land than reported
facts.text: Badan Geologi measured 32.8 ha of new land on the NW-W-SW shore from Sentinel images. On the west and north-west shore NISAR finds only about 3.6 ha; its 26.5 ha in all sit mostly further south.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | Badan Geologi via detik https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8676571/analisis-badan-geologi-soal-munculnya-daratan-baru-di-dekat-anak-krakatau

facts.title: A new islet ~760 m off the NW coast: NISAR doesn't see it
facts.text: Badan Geologi reported a new islet about 760 m off the north-west coast, confirmed by sailors and Sentinel images by 23 September. NISAR finds no new bright target at sea within 500 m of the estimated spot. It may be too small or low, or lie elsewhere: only its distance from the coast was published.

facts.title: A new islet ~495 m off the SE coast: not seen either
facts.text: A second islet was reported about 495 m off the south-east coast. NISAR finds no new bright target within 500 m of the estimated spot. A rock a few tens of metres across, 770 m off the SE shore, shows on most passes both before and after, so it is not new.

facts.title: North-east and east shore: no new land
facts.text: The north, north-east and east shore gained no new land, as Badan Geologi also reported: NISAR finds 0.1 ha here.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | Badan Geologi via detik https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8676571/analisis-badan-geologi-soal-munculnya-daratan-baru-di-dekat-anak-krakatau
